scientific_intent.scientific_task: Sample two optical-flow correspondences, fit first-order motion center/expansion/rotation and count integer-pixel outliers to select minimum among accepted sampled models.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Displacement=(D*(x-cx)-R*(y-cy),D*(y-cy)+R*(x-cx)); source truncates each Float32 contribution separately before integer residual, excludes degenerate two-flow fits, accepts count<N*convergence and selects first rawappend minimum.
scientific_intent.discretization: Four finite synthetic pixel-correspondence sets N257/65/96/128 with M131/67/97/129 sampled pairs; only bounded Int32-safe fitting polynomial domain, exact Fraction solved-model oracle.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Every model parameter and accepted candidate ID/outliercount against independent oracle; strict candidate membership/count/minimum and bestID-minimizer membership, all actual GPU input echoes/80guards percase. Raw nondeterministic appendorder/bestID ties retained, not equal-valued numerical output.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Small bounded controlled optical flows; source5922correspondence input and default2000model repeatedCLI not certified.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: CPU original Int32 expanded fit polynomial checked overflow-safe; Float32 divisions and separate Float32multiply-to-Int32truncation pixel residual convention. Exact canonical property array equality, not general floating fit accuracy or geometric residual threshold convention.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: README explicitly identifies first-order optical-flow egomotion and robust sample-consensus fitting; useful motion-model component. These synthetic operator checks do not demonstrate camera-motion accuracy, probabilistic recovery success or globally optimal fitting.
